name: v0.3.21 — Receipt detail rebrand: Fetch-style hero + clean card layout
releaseNotes:
• Mobile receipt detail screen rebranded to match the Fetch design pattern. Orange gradient hero with the receipt total as the big headline number, back/prev/next/image/edit action row up top, decorative sparkles, and a zigzag bottom edge for the torn-receipt look.
• Below the hero: centered store name + 'date • total' subtitle. Worth-It? row replaces the old inline rating with a 44px avocado tile + tappable stars. Items render as a single clean list (name left, $ right) with subtle dividers — tap any item to open the per-item rating bottom sheet.
• Bottom action footer with 'Snap another' (outline) and 'Done' / 'Skip rating' (filled) — matches the Fetch reference. Re-parse with Guac-AI button preserved.
• Helper banner ('🔍 Rate this receipt to nudge your GuacScore') appears when the receipt is unrated.
